about: Panniers and top boxes for the adventure bikes (beenster 17 Nov: only as options for adventure bikes). luggage3d.py builds them on the lead adventure bike; every adventure bike shares the same rear rack, so they fit all five.

panniers.name: Aluminium side boxes, silver
panniers.note: Square brushed aluminium boxes with black corner caps, a lid seam, two latches and a carry handle.

panniers.name: Aluminium side boxes, black
panniers.note: The same boxes in black anodised aluminium with silver corner caps.

panniers.name: Hard shell side cases
panniers.note: Rounded dark grey moulded cases, wider at the top, with a brushed panel on the outside.

panniers.name: Soft adventure bags
panniers.note: Olive canvas bags with a roll top and black straps and buckles, on the same side frames.

topboxes.name: Aluminium top box, silver
topboxes.note: A square brushed aluminium box with black corners, a backrest pad and a red reflector.

topboxes.name: Aluminium top box, black
topboxes.note: The same box in black anodised aluminium.

topboxes.name: Moulded top case
topboxes.note: A rounded dark grey case with a red reflector strip across the back.
